mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the slowing industrial sector weighs on the broader economy.
failure_condition: INDPRO falls below 50 but SPX posts positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5 percentage point rise over 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp over 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, indicating a restrictive monetary policy stance, it predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as higher borrowing costs weigh on economic activity.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% but SPX posts positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) are in year-over-year decline, it signals a broad-based weakening of consumer demand that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Both HOUST and RSAFS in y-o-y decline but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in payroll employment (PAYEMS), defined as a 200,000 decline over 3 months, signals a rapidly deteriorating labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS declines > 200k over 3 months but SPX posts positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3% and is accelerating, it signals rising inflationary pressures that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the Fed is forced to tighten policy.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3% and accelerating but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (INDPRO) is above 50 and rising, while the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5% and falling, it signals a Goldilocks economy of strong growth and low unemployment that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 50 and rising, UNRATE < 5% and falling, but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.
